capabilities: Create notes by picking folder cards through a Category or Domain question flow
Name the note with real-time duplicate-name checks and an optional Note type
Write category, domain, subdomain, and type into frontmatter and apply the type's template
Include or exclude folders from the flow with scoped folder-tree rules
Navigate the whole flow with the keyboard and quick-jump search
disambiguation: It does not reorganize or move existing notes; it only creates new ones by walking down your existing folder tree.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It runs fully offline with no accounts, network requests, or telemetry.
problem: Creating a note drops it at the vault root or the last-clicked folder, so filing it correctly takes extra mental overhead.
summary: Guided note creator that turns your vault's folder tree into question-by-question cards, then names the note and files it with frontmatter filled in.
